units.source_text: “快要下雪了，红叶的季节也快过去了。”

en.t: It looks like it will snow soon, and the season of autumn leaves is almost over too.

units.source_text: 她说着走到外面，“这一带都是山沟沟，还挂着红叶就下雪了。”

en.t: She said this as she went outside: Around here it is all mountain hollows, so snow falls while the autumn leaves are still hanging on.
